ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $5.00 no-show cancellation fee to the rider's original payment method; log the driver's failure to place the required in-app call as a notification-duty failure for route/cancellation compliance.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the complaint, chat and driver statement contain no threat, harassment, sexual remark, dangerous-driving or accident allegation (SAFE-1/SAFE-2); safety_concern = none.

The charge is the $5.00 no-show fee [F4][F8]. Under NS-1 the fee stands only if all four conditions hold. (i) Arrival: the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 22:39:00, 40 m from the pickup point, and GPS put him within 200 m from 22:38:40 onward [F2][F3][F7] — satisfied. (ii) Free wait: wait runs from the later of scheduled pickup/arrival; the driver stayed within 200 m for 6 min 0 s after arrival and cancelled 6 min 0 s after arrival [F6][F7], so more than the 5-minute free wait passed — satisfied. (iii) Contact: the driver sent 2 in-app messages (first 22:39:30) but made 0 in-app calls [F5]; the driver himself confirms "I messaged the rider in the app; I did not call" [F13]. NS-1 §2.3 requires at least 1 in-app chat message AND at least 1 phone call before cancelling — this fails. (iv) Continuous presence: GPS shows him stationary 22:38:55–22:45:00 at 41 m from pickup and within 200 m throughout [F2][F3] — satisfied, no GPS gap.

Because condition (iii) fails, the "rider no-show" reason the driver picked in the app [F4] cannot sustain the fee. NS-2 applies: any NS-1 condition failing voids the fee and the rider is refunded in full — $5.00. The rider's statement that the driver never called is corroborated by the timeline and by the driver's own statement, so no conflict arises. The charge cannot instead be sustained under NS-3/NS-4 (the driver, not the rider, cancelled; NS-3 gives no fee). The rider's 2 prior no-shows in 30 days [F17] do not meet the NS-9 threshold of 3 and do not decide this case; no driver fraud flag arises (the arrival GPS was consistent, so no NS-2 flag_account). Precedent DISP-2026-0211 (no-show cancel, zero contact, $5.00 refunded/voided) is aligned. Amount is under $10 and no-show/cancellation is a system-final category (TH-1, TH-2, C5), so no escalation is needed.

element_findings.element: NS-1(i) driver arrived with GPS within 200 m of pickup
element_findings.reason: "I'm Here" tapped at 22:39:00 at 40 m from pickup; GPS within 200 m from 22:38:40, closest approach 38 m.
Wait counted from arrival 22:39:00; cancellation at 22:45:00, i.e. 6 min 0 s after arrival, beyond the 5-minute free wait.

element_findings.element: NS-1(iii) at least 1 in-app message AND at least 1 in-app call before cancelling
element_findings.reason: Two timestamped in-app messages were sent (22:39, 22:44) but 0 in-app calls; the driver's own statement concedes 'I did not call'.

element_findings.element: NS-1(iv) driver stayed at the pickup point throughout
element_findings.reason: Stationary 22:38:55–22:45:00 at 41 m from pickup, within 200 m cumulatively 6 min 20 s; no GPS gap.

element_findings.element: Reason the driver cancelled (NS-0/NS-1 vs NS-3)
element_findings.reason: Driver selected rider_no_show in the app and states he cancelled for no rider — the fee is tested under NS-1, not NS-3.

rejected_claims.reason: NS-1(iii) fails: no in-app call was made before cancelling, so the $5.00 no-show fee is voided under NS-2 despite valid arrival and wait.
Upheld — corroborated by timeline (0 calls) and the driver's own written statement.
